text:
jess: Need a crisp benchmark narrative for next week's launch. Objective: homepage hero stat + one explainer chart for the blog + two webinar slides. Keep tradeoffs simple: latency vs cost.

omar: Hero idea: single KPI = 'Median latency at typical seq len' with a subline '$/1k tokens at typical throughput'. Use p50 for headline and p95 in details.

talia: Chart suggestions: 1) Cost-vs-latency scatter for common models (point size = throughput). 2) Small multiples by workload (chat, summarization, embeddings) showing pct cost delta vs baseline. Scatter works great for interactive webinar demo.

frank: Routing + CTA: homepage buttons "Try cost-optimized" and "Try low-latency" -> two landing pages with pre-selected presets. Webinar signup should include a use-case field so we can route enterprise vs self-serve. Also plan a simple UTM to track which CTA converts better.

jess: Good call on p50. Ops note: when we report $/1k, we must specify "includes avg infra overhead" and include test config (batching, seq dist) in appendix.

ops-bot: Heads up: staging slot for benchmark landing reserved at 1976660000. Please open PRs to marketing/bench-landing by Thu 15:00 UTC.

talia: I'll mock the scatter + small-multiples by Wed EOD. Omar can you provide CSV with columns [model, workload, p50_ms, p95_ms, cost_per_1k, throughput]?

omar: Yes, will export both hosted and dedicated runs and include metadata as a separate file. ETA Thu EOD.

jess: Action items: Talia -> visuals; Omar -> CSV + meta; Frank -> CTA copy + routing rules; I'll draft hero headline options for review.

frank: Suggest headline options: "Cut inference costs without slowing responses" or "Predictable latency, better unit economics." We'll A/B test which resonates.

jess: Perfect. Keep messages short. We'll reconvene Fri AM to pick hero and chart.
